description: A panel of five classic bitcoin cycle measures, each counted from the server's own price record and printed with its own number and the window behind it: the Pi Cycle Top pair (the 111-day average against the doubled 350-day average, the gap in percent, and the pair's past crossing dates in the record), the Mayer Multiple (today's price over the 200-day average, with the counted share of past days at or below today's), the distance from the 200-week average, the halving clock (days since the April 2024 halving, with the lengths of the three finished cycles), and the Ahr999 index with its formula in plain words. Each measure also prints the counted share of its own past readings at or below today's. It may add one labeled guest number, the Fear & Greed Index from Alternative.me, with its source and date; the guest feeds nothing else. There is no blended score: the panel closes with a count of how many of the five readings sit below the middle of their own past range. Call it when the user asks where bitcoin sits in its market cycle, or names one of these measures. Descriptive only: no verdict, no advice, no prediction.
name: cycle_check
title: Bitcoin cycle check
